tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Compilation of results.
footnotes: Critical micelle concentration (cmc in µM units), effective charge (zeff) of the peptide, partition coefficient of insertion (Kins), effective partition coefficient (Keff), molar enthalpy of partitioning ( in kJ/mol units), minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC in µM units) and the haemolytic potency is given as the concentration H5 (in µM units) at which 5% haemolysis has been obtained. Membrane partitioning data for PAMPX, Leu8, Adec1, Adec8, Adec14 and OAMPX could not be analysed and these cells are marked with a dashed line.
